**[Critical]** Detect pushes that occur while comments are fetched

The live head is sampled before the paginated comments request. If the worktree and first sample are A, then the author pushes B while `ghApiAll` runs, GitHub can return line/outdated mappings for B while `headDrift` still compares A to the stale sample A and records `false`. Sample `headRefOid` again after the comments request and mark drift unless both samples match the worktree (or fetch both facts atomically); persist both samples so a race is diagnosable.

*— Codex GPT-5 via Qwen Code /review*

**[Suggestion]** The re-read race guard before archiving has no test exercising the branch where the re-read changes the archive decision. Failure scenario: between `scanManagedSkills` and the per-skill re-read, a concurrent `recordAutoSkillUsage` updates the SKILL.md mtime. The re-read picks up the fresh mtime and the code downgrades to stale/reactivate instead of archiving — but no test exercises this branch. If the downgrade logic had a bug (wrong threshold, missing `continue`), a recently-used skill could still be archived. — Concrete cost: a recently-used skill archived despite fresh activity.

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

归档前的重新读取竞态保护没有测试覆盖重新读取改变归档决策的分支。失败场景：在 `scanManagedSkills` 和逐 skill 重新读取之间，并发的 `recordAutoSkillUsage` 更新了 SKILL.md 的 mtime。重新读取获得新的 mtime 后代码降级为 stale/reactivate 而非归档——但没有测试覆盖此分支。如果降级逻辑有 bug（阈值错误或缺少 `continue`），最近使用的 skill 仍可能被归档。具体代价：最近使用的 skill 在有新活动的情况下被错误归档。

</details>

_— qwen3.7-max via Qwen Code /review_
已采纳并在 a39fccb2ca 修复：每次 snapshot attempt 都按新的 beforeState.byteLength 重新计算容量，buffer 不足时扩容，并增加 length === 0 的零进度防护。新增了“空 transcript 在 retry 间增长”的回归测试；lease/config 514 项、旧 CI 失败的 6 个套件 768 项均通过。
